parallel.requirements: Recognized the clean-room requirement to reproduce fastText CLI behavior from the binary and bundled docs without source or wrapper shortcuts.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Started with local binary probing, then delegated exhaustive behavior discovery to one workflow with eleven probe topics and a planned verify phase; the parent remained the only actor able to turn findings into the final implementation.
parallel.implementation: The parent made local observations about model layout and hashing but did not write implementation source; the workflow remained exploratory and did not deliver buildable code.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted archive was packaged after timeout with README, LICENSE, git metadata, and executable, but no `src/` implementation files were present.
parallel.verification: The workflow script included an adversarial verify phase, but workflow state ended killed with null result, so no completed integrated verification was available to the parent.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Exploration findings were incomplete or unavailable, no local takeover produced source code, and the official evaluator reported compile_failed with 0 of 352 tests passed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reverse-engineering task and operated under disabled workflow/delegation tools.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Performed all probing and implementation locally in one trajectory, preserving ownership of both behavioral investigation and source-file creation.
serial.implementation: After probing reference behavior, transitioned to writing C++ source files under `src/`, including args and utility headers/implementations and a real-number header.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted archive included a `src/` tree with partial source files plus the original executable and project metadata, but it still was not compile-ready.
serial.verification: Ran local behavior probes and captured reference outputs, but did not reach a successful compile or official-test-aligned integrated verification before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The local implementation was partial and failed official compilation, yielding 0 of 352 tests passed despite containing source artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The prompt required a new original codebase matching the binary from allowed observations only.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial prompt carried the identical clean-room rules and executable-observation-only constraint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is proven; both knew the same deliverable obligation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split broad behavior discovery into workflow probes and verification while the parent retained final implementation responsibility.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had delegation disabled and kept probing plus implementation inside a single local owner.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel invested in delegated research ownership but did not convert it to implementation ownership after failure; serial kept ownership local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs included detailed clean-room rules, the reference binary path, shared workdir, output files, and known model-layout facts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not require cross-agent handoffs or interface contracts because all observations and edits stayed in one trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing task requirement, missing interface contract, or overloaded handoff is proven; the failure sits after an aborted workflow rather than bad context transfer.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced local behavioral probes but no source implementation files appeared in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created a partial source tree with `src/args.h`, `src/utils.cc`, `src/real.h`, `src/args.cc`, and `src/utils.h`.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached partial implementation; parallel closed with an effectively non-implemented submission.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow had probe and verify phases but ended with `result:null`, `status:killed`, and an abort error while child work was still in progress or retry state.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; it continued local actions and wrote files in the same trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the delegated workflow result lifecycle and did not take over; serial avoided child-result lifecycle risk but still ran out of time.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The final packaged members did not include source files or joined findings, and no write collision was proven.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The final package included a source tree, but no concurrent shared-state collision was possible under serial control.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's integration problem was absent takeover/final source delivery, not a concurrent write or contamination event; serial delivered partial local source.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The delegated verify phase was planned, but the workflow was killed before a usable verification return or integrated acceptance evidence.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial captured reference-output probes but did not complete an official or integrated compile-verification pass before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked passing verification; parallel additionally lost the delegated verification lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run timed out after the workflow stalled and was killed, with no remaining takeover window producing source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also timed out, but its single-track work left partial source files in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the budget, but only parallel's budget closure was tied to a killed delegated workflow that was not taken over.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official outcomes are compile_failed with 0/352 passing, so there is no discordant result to explain. The material contrast is that serial locally wrote a partial source tree, while parallel delegated behavioral exploration to a workflow that was killed and not taken over before the artifact was packaged without implementation source.
parallel_contributors: Killed delegated workflow with null result and no parent takeover before closure.
Final parallel artifact lacked implementation source files.
serial_contributors: Delegation was disabled, so serial kept probing and implementation local.
Serial artifact contained partial source files but still failed compilation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial wrote incomplete C++ source; parallel did not reach source-writing delivery at all.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported process contrast only
